publication.title: Facet Graphs: Complex Semantic Querying Made Easy

adjudication.basis: Facet Graphs/gFacet supports iterative RDF hierarchical filtering and result pivots across connected facets, with colour-coded filter effects. Full system report includes a within-subject comparator study.

tasks: Three football query types, order balanced

descriptions.interaction: Choose result class, add/remove hierarchical facet nodes, select/deselect facet values conjunctively, sort/page/scroll node lists and pivot result role without replacing graph layout.
descriptions.guidance: Facet/class choices ranked by counts; restrict displayed options to connected objects to avoid empty sets; colour-coded paths/rings trace filter causes and effects; pinned layout preserves position.
descriptions.visualisation: Facet lists embedded in graph nodes, directed labelled relations, force-directed layout with delayed pinning, filter-cause colours/rings.
descriptions.backend: Client-generated SPARQL via HTTP/XML; Adobe Flex/Flash interface, DBpedia demonstration and arbitrary endpoint aspiration without server changes.
descriptions.evaluation: 2×3 tool-by-task within-subject comparative study, tool order balanced across two groups

resources.notes: Current GET evidence only. HTTP success is not proof of repository code, valid license, reproducible installation or working demo; source identity review is required.

Facet Graphs/gFacet supports iterative RDF hierarchical filtering and result pivots across connected facets, with colour-coded filter effects. Full system report includes a within-subject comparator study.
Primary evaluation description

report_level_evaluation.design: 2×3 tool-by-task within-subject comparative study, tool order balanced across two groups
report_level_evaluation.participants: n: 10; details: 8 men/2 women, age24–31 mean28.3, computer familiarity and normal/corrected vision without colour blindness
report_level_evaluation.tasks: Three football fact-finding task types, increasing need for hierarchical/conjunctive filtering
report_level_evaluation.measures: Correct solutions; Tool evaluation questionnaires; Direct final comparison
report_level_evaluation.results: Parallax equal/better on first two simple tasks; gFacet failed task2 in four cases. Authors report gFacet better on complex task3 and relation comprehension; no named statistical test/p value in main text.; limits: Distinct2010 report/study from gFacet2008; do not transfer the2008 eye-tracking design or pool samples.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Distinct2010 report/study from gFacet2008; do not transfer the2008 eye-tracking design or pool samples.
